records.text: Viewer handle Lulu alleged David Leavitt and his wife took a child to Scotland, bought a castle and kept her away from her family. Owens immediately added “allegedly,” said she did not know whether it was true, and disclaimed knowledge of a child being taken to Scotland.
records.speaker: Lulu (viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Lulu writes, keep following the David Leavitt stuff. It is deep. We are the people. Utah has everything that you need to know about. ... know about this case. David (David O. Leavitt) and his wife took this child to Scotland and bought a castle and kept her there away from her family. ... I'm going to add allegedly, allegedly, I'm obviously live reading comments. And so I don't know if there's any truth to that. ... And you are implying that there's a safety issue there. I do not know that. I know nothing about a child being taken to Scotland, but I will look more into David O. Leavitt because I do think that that is an interesting thread that needs to be pulled.

conveyance.original_source: Viewer comment read by Owens with her immediate attribution caveat; commenter identity unverified

records.text: This has been going on for a very, very long time. And so they left France and they went into Scotland and they fought for Robert the Bruce and eventually this ends up in America. That's the short and thick version.
